thread:
Renee: Thinking of a low-key 'Silent Sip & Sketch' happy hour next Wednesday 6:30pm in the mezzanine. no amplified music, ambient lights, bring a sketchbook or your favourite pen. :pencil2: :cocktail:
Tom: love that. can we have a tiny silhouette portrait corner? i can bring a clamp lamp.
Keisha: i'm in. i'll bring charcoal and a few A4 pads for anyone who forgets theirs.
Ava: is this BYOB? i can bring a little non-alc spritz pitcher.
Liam: count me for setup 6pm. i can also bring folding stools.
event-bot: Quick poll! React :one: if you plan to sketch only, :two: if you plan to sip only, :three: if both. Poll closes in 48h.
Renee: sign-up sheet: https://tiny.rw/silent-sip-sketch (add if you're bringing any supplies or willing to demo a 2-min prompt).
Tom: idea: 2-minute improv sketch prompts every 10 minutes (not performance, just drawing prompts). who wants to run prompts?
Keisha: i'll moderate prompts. small rule: no shading contests, keep it friendly.
Ava: i'll bring name tags + tiny stickers for people who want their sketch critiqued (optional).
Liam: logistics Q: capacity for mezzanine ~40? we should RSVP so we don't overflow.
Renee: yep RSVP in sheet please by Monday noon. i'll order a few LED candles and table cloths.
Tom: food? maybe finger foods only. i can pick up a cheese board and some fruit.
Keisha: note: nuts in some cheese spreads. i'll label allergens. also i'll bring vegan coconut cookies.
Ava: i can make a small playlist of ambient loops (low volume). is that ok?
Renee: prefer low ambient, yes. also reminder: keep voices down after 8pm because of nearby meeting rooms.
Liam: volunteers for teardown at 8:45? i can lead.
Tom: i'll help teardown and take the chair stack.
Keisha: also mini sketch swap idea: bring one finished sketch to trade anonymously. fun?
Ava: omg yes, i love that. little paper fortune maybe on the back.
Renee: perfect. i'll add a column in the sheet for "bring-swap-sketch?"
event-bot: Reminder set for Tuesday 09:00: "Final RSVP + supply list"
Liam: one tiny ask: if you paint, please bring a drop cloth. we want to keep the furniture safe.
Renee: thanks everyone. see you Wednesday! :sparkles:
